svg.title: Change the required answer; keep the same 1,024 marbles
svg.desc: Two panels each show 512 candidate locations, red and blue. Exactly one marble across both bags is heavy, with all 1,024 locations equally likely. A reliable balance comparison of the two full groups identifies red if the red pan is heavier and blue if the blue pan is heavier. Before: bag entropy 1 bit, marble entropy 10 bits. After: bag entropy zero, marble entropy 9 bits. The dots are candidate locations, not revealed heavy marbles.

g.text: Change the required answer; keep the same 1,024 marbles
Exactly one heavy marble across both groups.
